source.text: doxologia.ro, 30 august — „Sfântul Ierarh Ioan, Patriarhul Constantinopolului”

attestations.note: doxologia.ro keeps him on 30 august, third of the three hierarchs Alexandru, Ioan and Pavel cel Nou, under one shared life; the Greek calendar read here keeps him on 25 August with Epiphanius. The shared life identifies him as «Sfântul Ioan care se numea Capadoc», who took the throne after Timothy — the same man the Greek entry calls John II.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 25 Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Επιφάνιος και Ιωάννης Αρχιεπίσκοποι Κωνσταντινουπόλεως»
